description: DeepSpeed is a deep learning optimization library that makes distributed training and inference easy, efficient, and effective.

latest_release.name: v0.19.9 Patch Release
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Update version post 0.19.8 release by @loadams in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8871
* Update to filter out version.txt from PR gates. by @loadams in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8872
* Skip the accelerator-only CPU optimizer tests on the cpu accelerator by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8836
* Keep Yuan's o_proj bias whole on every rank and describe it as replicated by @Achyuthan-S in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8857
* Expect AutoTP to keep a row-parallel output head tied to the embedding by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8855
* Add Triton kernels for vocab-parallel logprobs, entropy and KL by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8838
* Fix numerical stability in Triton masked softmax by @arcusbuilds in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8782
* Add RVV vectorized FP32 kernel to CPU Adam by @zhangjian29 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8817
* [OPSD] Request last-position logits only in HybridEngine rollout prefill by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8839
* docs: fix 30 dead links across README, docs pages, tutorials and posts by @pratikgx in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8688
* docs: fix remaining dead links in the Chinese README, tutorials and blog by @woodforestsen in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8894
* Bump modal-torch-latest CI Python from 3.10 to 3.12 by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8902
* [AffineIR] Plan expert transfers from the live runtime placement by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8800
* Set TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS=1 in modal CI sandbox to stop 300s test timeouts by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8914
* Fix scalar parameter byte-view broadcasts by @adenzhou1350 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8642
* Honor fp16 hysteresis in the ZeRO stage 0 fp16 optimizers by @vineethsaivs in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8647
* Strip ANSI color codes before parsing FAILED lines in cpu-multi-triage by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8882
* Bump AWS capacity-fallback Python from 3.10.13 to 3.12.14 by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8921
* AutoEP: fused Triton kernel for the clamped expert activations by @pengdurice in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8652
* Keep fp32 masters on ZeRO-1 and ZeRO-2 when a resume skips optimizer state by @sfc-gh-truwase in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8891
* Skip accelerator sync for unprofiled comm ops by @guptaishaan in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8795
* Fix performance regression caused by comms logger and bug in comms_logger.enabled by @hwchen2017 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8909
* Use nvtx's module-level API so NVTX domain ranges work on older nvtx releases by @hwchen2017 in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8900
* [AffineIR] Affine storage maps for live ZeRO parameters and optimizer states by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8885
* Add a v1 multi-rank CPU suite (manual dispatch first) by @delock in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8926
* [AutoEP] Ensure consistent order of partition groups in all-gather when ZeRO-3  by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8876
* Fix race between folded checkpoint load and metadata drop in AutoEP+AutoTP test by @jinyouzhi in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8943
* Check where column-split pieces write in a shard by @Achyuthan-S in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8922

## New Contributors
* @arcusbuilds made their first contribution in https://github.com/deepspeedai/DeepSpeed/pull/8782
* @zhangjian29 made their first contribution in https://github.com/deepspeedai/Deep
